title: Nine-stage low-read E8 composition: conditional kappa 0.000996761861969671
body:
Transplant #379's low-read E8 bit schedule into #381's nine-stage unsplit layout, keeping #377's nine-stage complex component unchanged. Exact pricing gives conditional **κ = 0.000996761861969671**, **0.11097150583734022% above #381** (0.000995656966441037). Bit coarse saving is 0.000997756388440101; complex coarse saving stays 0.000999240641319551. The bit side binds.

Only the local phase-B schedule changes. Its commuting elementary scalar additions are identical. The paid-rank change has a positive weighted second-difference decomposition, proving a strict recursive-moment decrease for every exponent between zero and one. Stock, rank mass, call count, fallback, width, and halving degree remain unchanged.

**Verification:** full local replay PASS at `26b8600364803eddd66c25a187c7fb8435b7f632`, including the complete #381 baseline and #377 component, exact candidate reconstruction, all 1,825 physical columns through nine stages, 18 omitted-bridge controls, six record mutations, frames, geometry, banks, finite accounting, two rational moment engines, all 47 outer inequalities, and adjacent-grid rejection. The initial draft replay exposed one missing nested provenance manifest; it was restored byte-for-byte from the pinned source in the current head. Both GitHub Python 3.11/3.14 replays and all 58 repository checks passed on that head. Dedicated run: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38118041701.

**Comparison update:** #382 appeared during submission and reports 0.000998243154231047, above this PR. This remains a reproducible +0.11097% improvement to #381's unchanged bit-word lineage, not a claim to beat #382.

The complete package is `research/e8-nine-stage-low-read/`; run `python -B research/e8-nine-stage-low-read/verify.py /fresh/output`. CI covers Python 3.11 and 3.14. Original source manifests, authorship, proof interfaces and dependencies are retained. Credits: #379 (eumemic / OpenAI Codex), #381 (DaysSky / Claude), #377 (Zhihao Chen / OpenAI Codex), and the suppliers credited in their notices. This PR contributes the composition and explicit second-difference certificate.

**Scope:** conditional on the inherited signed-integer lifting, nine-stage bridge, finite-bill/induction, Clifford/compiler, compressed-window, dirty-bank, common-grid, row, and all-size analytic interfaces. No new Lean proof or unconditional exponent claim. The three joint-dual metadata files reuse #318's source-pin repair without a mathematical change.
